This repository places the real Gradle wrapper under:
- content-rating-display-213568/vod_content_rating_frontend/gradlew

The root-level 'gradlew' and 'gradlew.bat' scripts delegate to that wrapper.
Use:
  ./gradlew :content-rating-display-213568:vod_content_rating_frontend:app:assembleDebug
or
  cd content-rating-display-213568/vod_content_rating_frontend && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
